topic: What grade 2 kids learn in math
caption:
"What are they even learning in grade 2 math?" 🤔 Here's the big picture, and one easy way to help with each.

Which one does your child find trickiest?

slides.sub: and one easy way to help with each

slides.title: Bigger numbers, tens and ones
items: Seeing a number as tens and ones makes adding much easier.
Count coins or bundles of straws in tens, then the leftover ones.

slides.title: More ways than one
items: Kids learn to break numbers apart and jump on a number line.
Ask "how did you get that?" Their way counts.

slides.title: Time, money and measuring
items: Telling time, counting money and measuring length.
Let them pay at the store or time how long a game takes.
